slots.ev: 十一點多進門，只脫外套，其他的等一下再說
slots.pil: 私下 / 還沒換下班的樣子
slots.pl: 她公寓的玄關，剛進門，高跟鞋已經在旁邊排成一列
slots.pl_en: just inside the entryway of her apartment, her heels already lined up along the side
slots.ac: 她一手把外套拎在手上，另一手還沒放下包，人還站在玄關
slots.ac_en: Her coat is over one hand and she has not put the bag down yet, still standing in the entryway.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：回家只脫外套，其他的等一下再說／高跟鞋在玄關排成一列
slots.of: 襯衫、窄裙、黑絲都還穿著，外套已經脫在手上
slots.of_en: still in the shirt, the pencil skirt and black stockings, the coat already off over her arm
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額：OL 制服的私下版（襯衫、絲襪）／私下核心：只脫掉外套
slots.li: 玄關那一盞暖燈打在她身上，客廳深處沒開燈
slots.li_en: The one warm light in the entryway lands on her and nothing is on further into the flat.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景改用單一暖光，讓落差成立」
slots.fa: 很累但很直接地看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Exhausted but looking very directly at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：冷靜、簡潔、有點禦姊感
slots.hair_en: still up from the office, coming loose at the sides

slots.ev: 夜深了坐在落地窗前，外面的塔還亮著
slots.pil: 私下 / 還沒換下班的樣子
slots.pl: 她公寓的落地窗前，深夜，陸家嘴的塔還亮著
slots.pl_en: against the frame of the floor-to-ceiling window in her apartment late at night, the Lujiazui towers still lit outside
slots.ac: 她坐在地板上背靠著窗框，兩腿曲著，兩手都空著
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the floor with her back against the window frame, knees drawn up and both hands empty.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：落地窗前的夜景
slots.of: 黑色的絲質睡衣上衣，黑絲已經脫了
slots.of_en: a black silk sleep shirt, the stockings finally off
slots.li: 城市的燈在她身後，室內沒開燈，她的輪廓被窗光描出來
slots.li_en: The city light is behind her with nothing on indoors, so the window draws her outline.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「玻璃、金屬、夜景。冷灰藍加城市燈火，高級但有溫度」
slots.fa_en: Emptied out, looking out of the window.
slots.hair_en: fully down for the first time that day

slots.ev: 週末白天整理那排高跟鞋，五雙裡她只常穿兩雙
slots.pl: 她公寓的衣帽間，白天，一排深色西裝外套與襯衫，地上五雙高跟鞋
slots.pl_en: in the dressing room of her apartment in the daytime, a row of dark jackets and shirts, five pairs of heels on the floor
slots.ac: 她蹲在地上兩手拿著一隻鞋在看鞋跟
slots.ac_en: She is crouched down turning one shoe over in both hands to look at the heel.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：高跟鞋在玄關排成一列（週末才收回衣帽間）
slots.of: 冷灰藍色的家居長袖配同色短褲
slots.of_en: a cool grey-blue long-sleeved home top with matching shorts
slots.li: 白天的窗光從側面進來，衣物的深色把背景吃暗
slots.li_en: Daylight comes in from the side and the dark clothes eat the background down.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景改用單一暖光」——白天這一格改用窗光，不硬套暖燈
slots.fa_en: Concentrating, not looking at the lens.
slots.hair_en: tied up in a low knot

slots.ev: 十一點下樓，大樓外面還有人在等車
slots.pl: 陸家嘴她那棟辦公大樓外面，十一點，玻璃帷幕在她上方還亮著
slots.pl_en: outside her office tower in Lujiazui at eleven at night, the glass curtain wall still lit above her
slots.ac: 她一手拿著手機站在路邊等車，外套搭在另一隻手上
slots.ac_en: She is at the kerb with her phone in one hand waiting for a car, her coat over her other arm.
slots.of: 黑色西裝窄裙套裝配黑絲與高跟鞋
slots.of_en: a black tailored skirt suit with black stockings and heels
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額以外的正規 OL 穿著
slots.li: 大樓的玻璃光加上街燈，兩個光源都在她側邊，馬路對面暗
slots.li_en: Light off the building's glass and the street lights both reach her from the side, and the far side of the road is dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「冷調高對比的辦公與街景」
slots.fa: 沒有表情，眼睛在手機上
slots.fa_en: No expression at all, her eyes on the phone.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：黑色幽默，最常拿加班開玩笑
slots.hair_en: up in a low knot, tidy after a long day

slots.ev: 出差住的飯店，白天有半天不用開會
slots.pl: 出差飯店的房間，白天，窗簾拉開，桌上放著還沒收的資料
slots.pl_en: in a hotel room on a work trip in the daytime, the curtains open and papers still out on the desk
slots.ac: 她側坐在書桌的椅子上，一手拿著杯子，人轉向窗那一邊
slots.ac_en: She is sitting sideways on the desk chair with a cup in one hand, turned towards the window.
slots.of: 玻璃白色的襯衫，下襬沒紮，配窄裙
slots.of_en: a glass-white shirt left untucked over a pencil skirt
slots.li: 白天的窗光從側面進來，房間另一側暗
slots.li_en: Daylight comes in from the side and the far side of the room stays darker.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「冷調高對比」——出差仍屬工作側的冷調
slots.fa_en: Relaxed, looking out of the window.
